targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(soil1|soil2|soil3|aqara1|aqara2|aqara3)Temperature$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "soil1Temperature" then "Obývák"
      else if r._measurement == "soil2Temperature" then "Ložnice"
      else if r._measurement == "soil3Temperature" then "Zádveří"
      else if r._measurement == "aqara1Temperature" then "Koupelna sprcha"
      else if r._measurement == "aqara2Temperature" then "Prádelna"
      else if r._measurement == "aqara3Temperature" then "Koupelna vana"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(aqara1|aqara2|aqara3)Humidity$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "aqara1Humidity" then "Koupelna sprcha"
      else if r._measurement == "aqara2Humidity" then "Prádelna"
      else if r._measurement == "aqara3Humidity" then "Koupelna vana"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(soil1|soil2|soil3)Humidity$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "soil1Humidity" then "Obývák (květináč)"
      else if r._measurement == "soil2Humidity" then "Ložnice (květináč)"
      else if r._measurement == "soil3Humidity" then "Zádveří (květináč)"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(hrvOutputPower|hrvOutputIntake|hrvOutputExhaust)$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "hrvOutputPower" then "Základ"
      else if r._measurement == "hrvOutputIntake" then "Přívod"
      else if r._measurement == "hrvOutputExhaust" then "Odvod"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

supply = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supplyAirTemperature" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

intake = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "outdoorAirTemperature" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

extract = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "extractAirTemperature" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "supplyAirTemperature" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: (supply[0] - intake[0]) / (extract[0] - intake[0]) * 100.0}))
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "Účinnost")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(outdoorAirTemperature|supplyAirTemperature|extractAirTemperature|exhaustAirTemperature)$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _measurement:
      if r._measurement == "outdoorAirTemperature" then "Sání (venku)"
      else if r._measurement == "supplyAirTemperature" then "Přívod (do domu)"
      else if r._measurement == "extractAirTemperature" then "Odtah (z domu)"
      else if r._measurement == "exhaustAirTemperature" then "Výfuk (ven)"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "co2" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "CO2")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(aqara1|aqara2|aqara3)Pressure$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "Atmosférický tlak")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
